name: dialog
title: Dialog
summary: Asks for a decision or a few values before going on, above a veil of the canvas.
use: To confirm something that cannot be undone, or for a short task that must finish first.
anatomy: Panel on canvas with a hairline and the media radius
Actions: secondary then primary, at the end

options.name: title
options.description: Required. A question or the task.

options.name: actions
options.description: One primary, at most one secondary.

rules: No shadows: the veil and the hairline separate the panel.
Escape and the cancel action close it.
accessibility: Focus moves into the dialog and returns when it closes.
